cues.en: Now that we're done with the health check, we can modify the existing db.py file.
cues.zh: 健康檢查完成後，現在修改既有的 db.py。

cues.en: Let's open it up that db.py in backend app core.
cues.zh: 開啟 backend/app/core/db.py。

cues.en: Remember, the code in this file was to help us set up a database connection, manage the database sessions, and initialize our database.
cues.zh: 記得，這個檔案負責建立資料庫連線、管理工作階段，以及初始化資料庫。

cues.en: We're going to modify this file so that we can optimize for database performance, manage our database resources well, and make our database operations more robust in terms of error handling and automatic
cues.zh: 接下來修改它，最佳化資料庫效能、妥善管理資源，並透過錯誤處理與自動

cues.en: retries.
cues.zh: 重試，讓資料庫操作更穩健。

cues.en: So let's start this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: So at the top we're going to import async IO like that.
cues.zh: 最上方匯入 asyncio。

cues.en: Then from SQL alchemy we're going to import something else.
cues.zh: 再從 SQLAlchemy 匯入其他項目。

cues.en: So you can say from SQL alchemy dot pull.
cues.zh: 從 sqlalchemy.pool，

cues.en: We're going to import the async adapted queue pool like that.
cues.zh: 匯入 AsyncAdaptedQueuePool。

cues.en: Then from SQL alchemy again we're going to import text just like that.
cues.zh: 再從 sqlalchemy 匯入 text。

cues.en: Then after initializing our logger previously we had created these async database engine.
cues.zh: logger 初始化之後，原本已建立非同步資料庫引擎。

cues.en: Now we're going to modify this engine to add some connection pooling configuration to it.
cues.zh: 現在修改引擎，加入連線池設定。

cues.en: Connection pooling is basically the practice of managing a pool of database connections to reuse them instead of creating new ones.
cues.zh: 連線池是管理一批資料庫連線，以便重複使用，而不是每次建立新連線。

cues.en: This basically helps us to improve the performance by reducing the overhead of establishing and tearing down connections for each request.
cues.zh: 這能減少每個請求建立與拆除連線的額外成本，改善效能。

cues.en: So how do you do that?
cues.zh: 該怎麼做？

cues.en: We're going to go back to our create async engine.
cues.zh: 回到 create_async_engine。

cues.en: Then just create some space like that.
cues.zh: 留一點空間。

cues.en: After the database URL settings we're going to add some more settings.
cues.zh: DATABASE_URL 之後，再加入一些設定。

cues.en: So the first one is going to be the pool class.
cues.zh: 第一個是 poolclass。

cues.en: And we're going to set that to the async adapted pool.
cues.zh: 設為 AsyncAdaptedQueuePool。

cues.en: So here what we're basically doing is we're using this async adapted tuple to create a connection pool.
cues.zh: 也就是使用 AsyncAdaptedQueuePool 建立連線池。

cues.en: And this pool is going to maintain a queue of connections to the database that can be reused.
cues.zh: 這個池會維護可重複使用的資料庫連線佇列。

cues.en: And that's a benefit to us because we're going to be reusing connections instead of creating new ones and thus reducing the database connection overhead.
cues.zh: 好處是重用連線，不必建立新連線，減少資料庫連線的額外成本。

cues.en: So after that setting we're going to add a pool underscore pre then ping.
cues.zh: 接著加入 pool_pre_ping。

cues.en: Then we're going to set that to true like that.
cues.zh: 設為 True。

cues.en: So this configuration enables the health checks before providing a connection from the pool.
cues.zh: 這會在從連線池提供連線前，先進行健康檢查。

cues.en: This is going to help us to detect stale connections before they are used.
cues.zh: 有助於在使用前偵測失效的連線。

cues.en: Then we're going to set the maximum number of permanent connections to keep in the pool.
cues.zh: 接著設定池中永久保留的最大連線數。

cues.en: As you can see, the pool size that's going to be five.
cues.zh: pool_size 設為 5。

cues.en: So here what we basically mean is maintain up to five connections to the database at any time.
cues.zh: 也就是最多維持五個資料庫連線。

cues.en: Then we're going to set the maximum number of additional connections that can be created beyond the pool size.
cues.zh: 接著設定超出 pool_size 時，可額外建立多少連線。

cues.en: As you can see maximum underscore overflow.
cues.zh: 設定 max_overflow。

cues.en: And we're going to set that to ten.
cues.zh: 值是 10。

cues.en: Meaning we shall allow up to ten additional connections to be created beyond the pool size.
cues.zh: 也就是允許在池大小之外，再建立最多十個連線。

cues.en: Then we're going to define the number of seconds to wait for a connection from the pool before giving up.
cues.zh: 接著定義從池中等待連線的秒數，超過就放棄。

cues.en: So you can say pool underscore timeout.
cues.zh: 設定 pool_timeout。

cues.en: We're going to set that to 30.
cues.zh: 值是 30。

cues.en: Meaning we shall wait for 30s to get a connection from the pool before timing out.
cues.zh: 也就是最多等待三十秒取得連線，超過就逾時。

cues.en: Then we're going to define the number of seconds after which a connection is recycled.
cues.zh: 再設定連線經過多少秒後要回收。

cues.en: This is going to help us prevent stale connections from being used.
cues.zh: 這有助於避免使用失效連線。

cues.en: As you can say pool underscore recycle.
cues.zh: 設定 pool_recycle。

cues.en: And we're going to set that to 30 minutes, which is 1800 seconds just like that.
cues.zh: 值是三十分鐘，也就是 1800 秒。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: That's it for our connection pool configuration.
cues.zh: 連線池設定就完成了。

cues.en: And remember, we're doing all this so that we can reduce the database connection overhead and handle connection life cycles automatically.
cues.zh: 記得，這些設定能減少資料庫連線成本，並自動管理連線生命週期。

cues.en: Then after doing all that, let's proceed with our modifications.
cues.zh: 完成後，繼續修改。

cues.en: So right here we created an asynchronous session factory so that we can create database sessions.
cues.zh: 這裡原本建立了非同步工作階段工廠，用來產生資料庫工作階段。

cues.en: We're not going to make any changes right here.
cues.zh: 這裡不做修改。

cues.en: Then we're going to go to this function.
cues.zh: 接著到這個函式。

cues.en: And now here is where we're going to use a fast API's dependency injection system to get a database session.
cues.zh: 這裡會透過 FastAPI 相依注入系統，取得資料庫工作階段。

cues.en: So what you can do is let me just clear all of this.
cues.zh: 先清除這些內容。

cues.en: We're going to refactor everything.
cues.zh: 我們要重新整理。

cues.en: And so now what you're going to do we are first going to create a new database session using the session factory.
cues.zh: 首先透過工作階段工廠，建立新的資料庫工作階段。

cues.en: By saying session that's going to be async session like that.
cues.zh: 設定 session = async_session()。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 接著加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: Within the try block, we're going to yield the session to be used by the route handler.
cues.zh: 在 try 裡 yield 出 session，供路由處理函式使用。

cues.en: This is going to allow fast API to manage the session lifecycle.
cues.zh: 讓 FastAPI 管理工作階段生命週期。

cues.en: So you can say yield session.
cues.zh: 寫 yield session。

cues.en: Then we're going to have our accept block.
cues.zh: 接著 except 區塊。

cues.en: As you can see accept exception.
cues.zh: 寫 except Exception。

cues.en: Then what we're going to do we're going to log any errors that occur during the session usage by saying logging dot error.
cues.zh: 使用 logger.error，記錄使用工作階段時發生的任何錯誤。

cues.en: Then in f strings we're going to say database assertion error then passing the error E like that.
cues.zh: f-string 寫「資料庫工作階段錯誤」，傳入 e。

cues.en: And so what I can even do is I can give our exception an alias.
cues.zh: 所以要為這個例外取個別名，

cues.en: So I can say here except exception as e like that.
cues.zh: 改成 except Exception as e。

cues.en: Then you pass in the error right there in our logger.
cues.zh: 再將 e 傳給 logger。

cues.en: Then in case of an error we're going to attempt to rollback any pending transactions.
cues.zh: 發生錯誤時，嘗試復原任何尚未提交的交易。

cues.en: So you can say if assertion then we're going to have another try block.
cues.zh: 如果 session 存在，就再加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: And we're going to attempt to rollback any pending transactions by saying await session dot rollback like that.
cues.zh: 呼叫 await session.rollback()，嘗試復原尚未提交的交易。

cues.en: Then we can log this by saying logger.info.
cues.zh: 再用 logger.info 記錄，

cues.en: Then we can say successfully rollback session after error like that.
cues.zh: 訊息是「發生錯誤後，已成功復原工作階段」。

cues.en: Then we're going to have our accept block.
cues.zh: 接著加入 except 區塊。

cues.en: And so we can say except exception as we can give this exception an alias.
cues.zh: 寫 except Exception as，再為例外取名，

cues.en: And we can call this rollback underscore error.
cues.zh: 叫 rollback_error。

cues.en: Then we're going to log any errors that occurred during the rollback.
cues.zh: 再記錄復原過程中發生的錯誤。

cues.en: As you can say logger dot error.
cues.zh: 呼叫 logger.error。

cues.en: And in f strings we can say error during the session.
cues.zh: f-string 寫「工作階段發生錯誤，於」，

cues.en: Rollback.
cues.zh: 接上「復原期間」。

cues.en: Then we pass in our rollback error.
cues.zh: 再傳入 rollback_error。

cues.en: Then at the same level as this if block, we're going to erase the original exception to be handled by Fastapi.
cues.zh: 接著退回和 if 同一層，重新拋出原始例外，交給 FastAPI 處理。

cues.en: So how do you do that.
cues.zh: 怎麼做？

cues.en: You just say raise like that.
cues.zh: 直接寫 raise。

cues.en: Then we remember we had that try block and accept block.
cues.zh: 記得，我們有 try 與 except 區塊。

cues.en: So we're going to have a finally block.
cues.zh: 再加入 finally。

cues.en: As you can see finally here we're going to always ensure that the session is closed even if an error occurs.
cues.zh: finally 會確保工作階段一定關閉，即使發生錯誤也一樣。

cues.en: So you can say if session then we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 如果 session 存在，就加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: We're going to close the database session by saying await session dot close.
cues.zh: 呼叫 await session.close()，關閉資料庫工作階段。

cues.en: Then we can log by saying logger dot debug.
cues.zh: 再用 logger.debug 記錄，

cues.en: And you can say database session closed successfully.
cues.zh: 訊息是「資料庫工作階段已成功關閉」。

cues.en: Then accept exception.
cues.zh: 接著 except Exception，

cues.en: This time we can give it an alias of close error.
cues.zh: 這次例外命名為 close_error。

cues.en: Then we're going to log any errors that occur while closing the session by saying logger dot error.
cues.zh: 用 logger.error 記錄關閉工作階段時發生的錯誤。

cues.en: Then in F strings we can say error closing database session.
cues.zh: f-string 寫「關閉資料庫工作階段時發生錯誤」，

cues.en: Then we're going to pass in the close error like that.
cues.zh: 再傳入 close_error。

cues.en: Then after that, we're also going to modify the init db function.
cues.zh: 接著也修改 init_db 函式。

cues.en: And we're going to initialize our database connections with the retry mechanism.
cues.zh: 我們會使用重試機制，初始化資料庫連線。

cues.en: Our function is going to verify that the database connection is working.
cues.zh: 函式會驗證資料庫連線是否正常，

cues.en: By attempting to connect to the database three times, with a delay of two seconds between each attempt.
cues.zh: 最多嘗試三次，每次間隔兩秒。

cues.en: So how do you do that?
cues.zh: 該怎麼做？

cues.en: We can get rid of pass.
cues.zh: 移除 pass。

cues.en: We're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: Then we're going to set the maximum number of connection attempts by saying maximum retries.
cues.zh: 設定最大連線嘗試次數，命名為 max_retries。

cues.en: We're going to set that to three then retry delay which is the delay between retries in seconds.
cues.zh: 設為 3。retry_delay 則是重試間隔秒數，

cues.en: That's going to be two.
cues.zh: 設為 2。

cues.en: Then we're going to attempt to connect to the database with exponential backoff.
cues.zh: 接著使用講者所稱的指數退避，嘗試連接資料庫。

cues.en: Exponential backoff is just basically a technique that increases the delay between retries exponentially.
cues.zh: 指數退避是一種讓重試間隔以指數方式增加的技術。

cues.en: You're going to see that, as you can see for any attempt in the range of our maximum retries, which is three, then what we're going to do, we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 接著會看到。for attempt in range(max_retries)，這裡是三次，再加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: And first we're going to create a new connection and execute a simple query by saying async with engine dot begin.
cues.zh: 先建立新連線並執行簡單查詢，寫 async with engine.begin()。

cues.en: Then you can give this an alias as US connection like that, then we're going to execute a simple Select query to verify the connection by saying await, then connection dot execute.
cues.zh: 以 as connection 命名連線，再呼叫 await connection.execute，執行簡單 SELECT 查詢，驗證連線。

cues.en: Then you can say text.
cues.zh: 傳入 text，

cues.en: And in double quotation marks we can say select one like that.
cues.zh: 雙引號裡寫 SELECT 1。

cues.en: Then if successful, we're going to log the success and break the retry loop.
cues.zh: 成功時記錄日誌，跳出重試迴圈。

cues.en: So you can say logger.info and you can say database connection verified successfully.
cues.zh: 呼叫 logger.info，訊息是「資料庫連線驗證成功」。

cues.en: Then we're going to break.
cues.zh: 再寫 break。

cues.en: Then if this was the last attempt, we're going to log an error and raise an exception by saying accept exception.
cues.zh: 若這是最後一次嘗試，就記錄錯誤並拋出例外，先加入 except Exception。

cues.en: Then we can say if the attempt was the last one by saying attempt double equals to maximum retries minus one, then let's log that.
cues.zh: 判斷 attempt == max_retries - 1，也就是最後一次，再記錄日誌。

cues.en: You can say logger dot error.
cues.zh: 呼叫 logger.error。

cues.en: And in instincts we can say failed to verify database connection after the maximum retries attempts
cues.zh: f-string 寫「經過 max_retries 次嘗試後，仍無法驗證資料庫連線」，

cues.en: like that, then we can raise.
cues.zh: 像這樣，接著 raise。

cues.en: Then we can log a warning for the failed attempt by saying Pacing logger dot warning in F strings.
cues.zh: 再為失敗的嘗試記錄警告，呼叫 logger.warning，使用 f-string。

cues.en: We're going to say database connection attempt then pass in the attempt plus one.
cues.zh: 訊息是「資料庫連線嘗試」，傳入 attempt + 1。

cues.en: Then we're going to implement our exponential backoff by waiting longer between each retry.
cues.zh: 接著透過每次等待更久，實作講者所稱的指數退避。

cues.en: The first retry is going to be two seconds.
cues.zh: 第一次重試等待兩秒。

cues.en: Then the second retry is going to be four seconds, the third retry six seconds, etc..
cues.zh: 第二次四秒，第三次六秒，依此類推。

cues.en: So you can now say here await async IO dot sleep.
cues.zh: 呼叫 await asyncio.sleep。

cues.en: Then we can say retry delay multiplied by attempt plus one like that.
cues.zh: 傳入 retry_delay * (attempt + 1)。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the final accept block of all this try block.
cues.zh: 最後加入整個外層 try 的 except 區塊。

cues.en: Here are the same line down there.
cues.zh: 就在下面同一層。

cues.en: We can now log any other unexpected errors during initialization by saying except exception as E, then
cues.zh: 用 except Exception as e，記錄初始化時其他非預期錯誤。

cues.en: what you can do is logger dot error and we can say database initialization failed.
cues.zh: 呼叫 logger.error，訊息是「資料庫初始化失敗」。

cues.en: Then you can pass in the error like that.
cues.zh: 再傳入錯誤。

cues.en: Then we can raise good and that's it for the modification to the db.py file.
cues.zh: 接著 raise。db.py 的修改就完成了。

cues.zh: 下一堂課修改 main.py。
